mapper.sql: select worker_record_id, stat_month, enterprise_id, enterprise_name, person_id, person_name, id_card, region_code, platform_name, employment_type, insurance_status, injury_insurance_status, monthly_income, warning_status, source_serial_no, source_status, source_message, callback_time, raw_payload, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from t_newform_worker
mapper.select: order by stat_month desc, worker_record_id desc

select stat_month, region_code, platform_name, count(1) as worker_count, sum(case when insurance_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as insured_count, sum(case when injury_insurance_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as injury_insured_count, sum(case when warning_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as warning_count, ifnull(sum(case when monthly_income is not null then monthly_income else 0 end), 0) as income_total, sum(case when monthly_income is not null then 1 else 0 end) as income_record_count, case when sum(case when monthly_income is not null then 1 else 0 end) = 0 then 0 else round( ifnull(sum(case when monthly_income is not null then monthly_income else 0 end), 0) / sum(case when monthly_income is not null then 1 else 0 end), 2 ) end as average_income from t_newform_worker
group by stat_month, region_code, platform_name order by stat_month desc, region_code asc, platform_name asc

select stat_month, region_code, platform_name, count(1) as worker_count, sum(case when injury_insurance_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as injury_insured_count, sum(case when injury_insurance_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as injury_uninsured_count, sum(case when injury_insurance_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as injury_stopped_count, sum(case when warning_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as warning_count from t_newform_worker
group by stat_month, region_code, platform_name order by stat_month desc, region_code asc, platform_name asc
mapper.insert: insert into t_newform_worker ( stat_month, enterprise_id, enterprise_name, person_id, person_name, id_card, region_code, platform_name, employment_type, insurance_status, injury_insurance_status, monthly_income, warning_status, source_serial_no, source_status, source_message, callback_time, raw_payload, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{statMonth}, #{enterpriseId}, #{enterpriseName}, #{personId}, #{personName}, #{idCard}, #{regionCode}, #{platformName}, #{employmentType}, #{insuranceStatus}, #{injuryInsuranceStatus}, #{monthlyIncome}, #{warningStatus}, #{sourceSerialNo}, #{sourceStatus}, #{sourceMessage}, #{callbackTime}, #{rawPayload}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
